technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with some structural bullish alignment (supertrend, Ichimoku cloud) are offset by lack of momentum confirmation, negative MACD, bearish candle pattern, and price below key moving averages—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: UPS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated earnings risk in 55 days with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — moderate amounts, mixed seniority, 82-113 days old
sentiment.summary: Moderate congressional buying interest combined with elevated market fear (31 Fear/Greed score) presents a contrarian buy setup, though signal age and lack of recent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (307.8), rising dollar headwind, NFP event in 2 days, and earnings in 55 days create compounded risk for UPS.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (12.84) with supertrend bullish and Ichimoku above cloud, combined with congressional buying and fear-zone contrarian opportunity, suggests potential mean-reversion bounce from support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Lack of momentum confirmation (negative MACD histogram, stochastic K at 2.25 with no cross, OBV flat, price below EMA 9/20), three black crows bearish pattern, macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 307.8), NFP in 2 days, and zero fundamental conviction create compounded downside risk that overshadows oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme RSI oversold (12.84) and congressional buying present contrarian appeal, lack of momentum confirmation (negative MACD, stochastic K at 2.25, OBV flat) and three black crows pattern indicate the bounce setup is premature and unconfirmed.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis environment (inverted yield curve, VIX 307.8, NFP in 2 days) combined with earnings in 55 days creates compounded downside risk that can overwhelm mean-reversion bounce; price may break support rather than recover.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, and risk agents all signal weakness; only sentiment offers contrarian support but insufficient to override consensus bear case
